title: Breakfast
body: Breakfast is served from 07:00 to 10:30 in the restaurant. Breakfast is included in the fictional villa stay. Pool breakfast requires confirmation from the hotel.

title: Arrival and departure
body: Check-in is from 15:00. Check-out is by 11:00. Late checkout depends on availability and must be confirmed by the hotel.

title: Cancellation
body: For this fictional flexible rate, cancellation is free until seven days before arrival. Contact the hotel to confirm the terms of your actual reservation.
